machine.name: Conveyor belt
machine.description: A simplified light-duty belt conveyor with drive, return pulley and support frame.

content.text: Original project-authored synthetic reference v1. A simplified light-duty belt conveyor with drive, return pulley and support frame. All numeric values and observations are invented for this educational fixture and must not configure real equipment. Review authorized lockout/tagout and verification of stored-energy isolation before physical access. Use correlated observations and compare competing causes. Relative motion and the controlled tension comparison support insufficient belt traction in this fixture. Slow speed alone cannot distinguish slip, overload or mechanical interference.

content.title: Throughput below target
content.briefing: A conveyor moves more slowly under its simulated load even though the drive command is unchanged. Correlate motion, drive and service records.
hints: Compare at least two independent observations before selecting a diagnosis.
A reading outside its training range is evidence, but does not establish a cause by itself.
steps: Review the simulated safety plan: authorized lockout/tagout, stored-energy isolation and verification before physical access.
Inspect the recorded visual evidence. This simulation does not authorize access to real machinery.
Read the archived condition measurements and compare them with this fixture's training envelope.
Compare the recorded operating history with a competing explanation.
Review the virtual verification evidence, then justify a diagnosis using the strongest observations.

evidence.label: Motion comparison
evidence.text: Archived marks show relative motion between the drive pulley surface and belt under the same virtual load.

evidence.label: Controlled verification
evidence.text: A simulated restoration of the specified fixture tension eliminates the relative motion at unchanged load.

evidence.label: Drive record
evidence.text: Current remains in the fixture's normal envelope; the virtual motor command has not changed.

evidence.label: Service history
evidence.text: The symptom follows a recorded belt replacement, with no corresponding change in load.

content.explanation: Relative motion and the controlled tension comparison support insufficient belt traction in this fixture. Slow speed alone cannot distinguish slip, overload or mechanical interference.
rationale_rubric: 0–10: connects the two distinguishing observations to the proposed cause; partial credit for a supported but incomplete link.
0–10: compares one credible alternative and explains what evidence weakens it; no credit for unsupported certainty.
